organization-general.title: Organization Settings
organization-general.subTitle: Manage the settings of the organization.
organization-general.readOnlyDesc: You are logged in as a **Member**. You are only allowed to view organization settings and do not have access to modify them.

logo.title: Organization logo
logo.desc: Upload a logo for your organization.

delete.title: Delete organization
delete.desc: Permanently delete your organization. Once you delete your organization, there is no going back. To confirm, please click the button on the right:
delete.dialogDesc: This action will permanently delete the organization {orgName} along with all associated memberships and subscriptions. This action cannot be undone.

alerts.successLogo: Organization logo successfully updated in database.
alerts.errorLoad: Failed to load organization details and permissions.

organization-member.title: Manage members
organization-member.subTitle: View and manage members, roles, and pending invitations.

inviteCard.title: Invite a member
inviteCard.desc: Add someone to your organization by sending them an email invite and assigning their role.
inviteCard.limitAlertDesc: Your organization has reached the maximum member limit for your current plan of **{max} members**. Please upgrade your plan in the **Billing** menu to add more members.

dialogDelete.title: Are you absolutely sure?
dialogDelete.desc: This action will remove {name} ({email}) from the organization. They will no longer have access to this workspace.

alerts.errorInvite: Failed to send invitation. Please check your MailerSend credentials.

organization-billing.title: Your current plan
organization-billing.desc: View your plan details and manage billing.
organization-billing.changeDesc: Compare available plans and switch your subscription.

dialogPurchase.title: Complete Your Purchase
dialogPurchase.desc: Complete payment to start using your service plan.

dialogRefund.title: Claim Refund
dialogRefund.desc: Are you sure you want to request a refund for the {planName} plan?
dialogRefund.warn1: Once submitted, your organization's premium access will be suspended while the review process is underway.
dialogRefund.warn2: *This review process takes 1-3 business days. Funds will be returned to the PayPal/Credit Card account used for the transaction.

alerts.successPay: Thank you! Payment for {planName} plan valued at {price} successfully processed. Order ID: {orderId}
alerts.successCancel: Automatic renewal disabled. Your premium access remains active until {date}.
alerts.successRefund: Refund claim successfully submitted and is under review.
alerts.errorPay: An error occurred during payment. Please try again.

account-general.title: Account settings
account-general.subTitle: Manage your general account settings.
account-general.avatarDesc: To change your avatar click the picture in this block and select a file from your computer to upload.
account-general.languageDesc: To change the language of the app for your account, select a language from the list and click save.
account-general.name: Your name
account-general.emailDesc: To change your email, enter the new email and hit save. You will have to confirm the new email before it will become active.
account-general.deleteDesc: Permanently delete your account. Once you delete your account, there is no going back. To confirm, please enter your password below:
account-general.dialogDesc: This action will permanently delete your account and all associated profiles from our database. This action cannot be undone.

account-security.title: Security settings
account-security.subTitle: Manage your account security, passwords, and active sessions.

password.title: Change password
password.desc: To change your password, click the button below to send an email to reset your password and follow the instructions in the email.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.desc: Use passkeys as a secure alternative to passwords.

tfa.title: Two-factor authentication
tfa.desc: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
tfa.warning: Password required. Set a password before enabling two-factor authentication. Your password is required to verify changes to this security setting.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.desc: These are all the active sessions of your account. Click the X to end a specific session.

users.title: Superadmin Users
users.desc: Manage, view, and oversee all registered user profiles and organization memberships.

data-table.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this user?

organizations.title: Superadmin Organizations
organizations.detail: Manage and oversee all registered organizations, active plans, member counts, and metadata.

dialogDelete.title: Are you absolutely sure?
dialogDelete.desc: This action will permanently delete the organization {orgName} along with all subscription records, transactions, and its members' memberships from the database. This action cannot be undone.

alerts.deletedDesc: Organization '{orgName}' and all of its associated data have been successfully deleted.
